facts.fact: O Telegrama states that Lei n.º 9/26 of 28 September 2026, in force on publication, sets up the National Cybersecurity System with a National Cybersecurity Centre for regulation, supervision and enforcement, and that CERT.ao sits within the Centre and coordinates the national response to incidents.

AGO.note: Mentions a growing data-centre ecosystem and clients' rights under the law, but names no facility for hire, Tier or cloud region.
The cybersecurity law is described; nothing on state data control, hosting or contract terms.

facts.fact: O Telegrama says Angola is connected by submarine cables to America and Europe, without naming cables or landing stations.

AGO.note: No data centre or owner named.
